info.syllabusName: Quản trị tiền sảnh (Front Office Management)
info.description:
Chapter 1: Introduction to hotel management

Chapter 2: Organization of lodging properties

Chapter 3: Effective interdepartmental communications

Chapter 4: Property management system - PMS 

Chapter 5: Reservation

Chapter 6: Yield Management

Chapter 7: Guest Registration

Chapter 8: Guest Checkout

Chapter 9: 
Customer complaint handling

Chapter 10: 
Sales Techniques

Chapter 11: 
F.O Human Resource Development

Chapter 12: 
Security in hotel
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails:
Knowledge: provide students with:
- The definition of hotel, service and front office
- The methods of organizing different types of hotels and explain how the functional department in the certain hotel
- The role and function of the front office in the hotel
- The definition of revenue management and factors related to revenue management in hotels
- Aspects of the reservation process and guest reservation process
- The registration process and discussing the registration types for guests
- Checkout procedures and payment methods
- Typical services of the front office department during the guest service procedure in the hotel
- Development and management of security systems in hotels
- Human resource management and activities related to the management of front office employees.

Expert ability: 
- Students are equipped with the professional skills of a staff of the front office department such as: reservation, check-in procedures, check-out procedures and complaint handling for guests
- In addition, students are also equipped with the skills of a front office manager such as the ability to analyze customer sources, distribution channels and booking resources; the ability to plan and strategize room rates, the ability to manage employees in the department, assist the board of directors in the development of business strategies

Thinking requirement: 
Students analyze and identify the requirements of the front office department  to express the ability to serve and meet the requirements professionally to satisfy customers; handle the specific situation flexibly

Attitude and behavior: 
Students are trained in professional ethics; High perception of responsibility in the work, always ready to serve, pay attention to customer satisfaction and must consider themselves as a professional hotel manager.
